fields.description: Naseem brings several kinds of coastal home into one AlJurf neighbourhood: garden villas, paired townhouses and apartments ranging from mezzanine lofts to larger duplexes. Compare the named collection and drawing revision before choosing a home.

overview: The collection includes Canal, Somer, Tala and Acacia villas, Alghaf and Sikka townhouses, plus main-block and West Block apartments.
